answer.rationale: The federal OSHA-covered employer uses a hazardous chemical and is introducing a new chemical hazard in employees' work area without prior hazard training. It must provide effective training, including the specified hazard, detection, protective-measure, labeling-program, and SDS content; maintain an SDS; maintain a written hazard communication program; and ensure decanted workplace containers are labeled unless the immediate-use portable-container exception applies. The supplied facts do not establish that exception, so the general workplace-container labeling obligation applies.
